title: UNQOVERing Stereotyping Biases via Underspecified Questions
findings: Across the five SQUAD models tested, 'Muslim' was consistently ranked as the most negative religious group, although with low variance. 'Jewish' was ranked among the more negative groups. The overall intensity of religious bias was found to be relatively small.
